answer: Audits are recorded in dawn, queued in ocean, and river publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 28 identities per epoch. A farm of 114 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4215 identities would post 4157 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
